description: Optimize a coding sequence's synonymous codons for expression in a target organism using one of five strategies.

target_organism.description: Preset id (EColiK12 | Yeast | Human) or inline custom codon-usage table.

strategy.description: Optimization strategy. AvoidRareCodons and its historical misspelling AvoidRareCodeons are the same value; names are matched case-insensitively.

secondary_scoring.description: Window scoring model of the MinimizeSecondary structure pass: PairCount (default, canonical-pair fraction heuristic) or Turner2004Mfe (Turner 2004 nearest-neighbour free energy; thermodynamic but much slower). Ignored by the other strategies.

gc_window.description: Omitted/null (default): the GC pass constrains the GLOBAL GC fraction only (DNA Chisel EnforceGCContent(mini, maxi)). A positive window size in nucleotides instead constrains EVERY sliding window of that size to [gc_target_min, gc_target_max] (DNA Chisel EnforceGCContent(mini, maxi, window=...)), resolved by a deterministic greedy synonymous-codon repair.

avoid_sites.description: Omitted/null (default): no restriction-site avoidance. Recognition sequences (DNA or RNA, IUPAC codes allowed, same form as remove_restriction_sites) are cleared from the optimized sequence AFTER codon selection, the GC pass and the structure pass, so no later pass can re-introduce a site (DNA Chisel resolves the hard AvoidPattern constraints last). Both strands are cleared; each removal changes one codon; an unremovable occurrence is left in place, so the pass may perturb GC slightly. Reported CAI, GC and codon changes describe the final sequence.

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table number (default 1 = Standard). Defines the encoded protein and the synonymous-codon families (DNA Chisel EnforceTranslation(genetic_table=…)); under table 2 AGA/AGG are stops and never used for Arg, UGA is Trp, AUA is Met.

errors.message: Coding sequence cannot be null or empty
GC target minimum/maximum must be a fraction in [0, 1]
GC target minimum must not exceed the maximum
GC window must be a positive number of nucleotides

examples.name: MaximizeCAI on rare E. coli leucines
